description: August 19 birthday meaning: Leo decan 3, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 19 birthday falls in Leo, in the third decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: August 19 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Nineteen reduces to 1, and with the Sun twenty-six degrees into Leo, August 19th is about as self-starting as dates come. Mars's decan adds boldness. The traditional portrait is of an independent, driven creator with a strong sense of personal style. The healthiest version of this birthday uses confidence to open doors for others too.

On August 19 the Sun usually sits at about 26° Leo, in the third decan, where Mars is the sub-ruler alongside Sun. The final third of Leo sits under Mars, ruler of Aries, and so mid-to-late August birthdays tend to carry the most forceful version of the sign. Courage, competitiveness and a readiness to defend people or principles are commonly associated with this decan. These Leos often lead from the front and prefer action to ceremony. Mars can make the temper quick and the pride prickly, especially when they feel challenged in public. The same fire gives them stamina for long campaigns. Channelling it into a cause bigger than personal recognition is often where this decan does its most memorable work.

sections.heading: August 19 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one August 19 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on August 19: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 19 is the 231st day of the year (232nd in a leap year). By August 23, 4 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Virgo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 19, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on August 19 include Bill Clinton (1946), Coco Chanel (1883) and Matthew Perry (1969).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 19?
faq.answer: August 19 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Leo, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 19 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 19?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 19 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 19?
faq.answer: August 19 is also the birthday of Bill Clinton (1946), Coco Chanel (1883) and Matthew Perry (1969). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
